examples.name: Inline validator function
examples.description: A collection with an inline validator function

settings.validator: function(doc) { if (!doc.name || doc.name.length < 3) { return { valid: false, error: 'Product name must be at least 3 characters' }; } if (!doc.price || doc.price < 0) { return { valid: false, error: 'Price must be non-negative' }; } return { valid: true }; }

examples.name: Function definition in functions collection
examples.description: A reusable function stored in system/functions

document.name: validate-email-user
document.description: Validates user documents with email requirements
document.code: function(doc) { const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/; if (!doc.email || !emailRegex.test(doc.email)) { return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid email address' }; } if (!doc.username || doc.username.length < 3) { return { valid: false, error: 'Username must be at least 3 characters' }; } return { valid: true }; }

examples.name: Collection with lifecycle hooks
examples.description: Collection with inline and referenced lifecycle functions

settings.onCreate: function(doc) { doc.created_at = new Date().toISOString(); doc.version = 1; return doc; }
settings.onDelete: function(doc) { console.log('Audit log deleted:', doc.uuid); return true; }

settings.validator: (doc) => { const required = ['event_type', 'timestamp', 'user_id']; const missing = required.filter(field => !doc[field]); if (missing.length > 0) { return { valid: false, error: `Missing required fields: ${missing.join(', ')}` }; } return { valid: true }; }

examples.name: Shared utility function
examples.description: A utility function that can be referenced by multiple collections

document.name: increment-version
document.code: function(doc, oldDoc) { doc.version = (oldDoc.version || 0) + 1; doc.updated_at = new Date().toISOString(); doc.updated_by = context.user.username; return doc; }
